_about: Official lists from your lookup service, used in New Enrolment (not on the Training page).
url: your lookup service. It can also be a path to a JSON file on this computer.
The reader loads the lists when it starts and again every refresh_minutes. A copy is kept in
data/lookups_cache.json and used when the service cannot be reached.
lists: place-name lists. 'source' = the names of the part of the answer that holds the list
(the first one found is used; when none is found the whole answer is searched).
'key' = the name field ({"district": "ILALA"}); 'require' = fields an entry must also have
(countries: an entry with "name" and "nationality"); 'aliases_from' = other spellings.
'parent' + 'parent_key' = the relation (a district's "regionId" is its region's id).
'parent_default' = the parent of entries that have no parent id: regions belong to the
country with code TZA. 'preferred' = the name taken whenever the writing looks like it.
Only entries with "active": true are used.
groups: fields that belong together on the form, section by section. 'postcode' = the field
filled from the region + district + ward postcodes of the group (postcode_from).
choices: tick-box fields whose values come from the lookup. 'boxes' = which lookup code each
printed box on the form means; 'depends_on' = marital status codes differ by sex.
A choice list missing from the answer keeps the form's own values.
Restart python run.py after editing this file. FORMREADER_LOOKUP_URL overrides url.

groups._where: Section A, item 13: primary school district
Section B, item 18: father's country of birth
Section B, item 23: mother's country of birth
Section C, items 25-28: place of birth
Section D, items 33-37: current residence (34 postcode filled in)
Section E, items 40-45: permanent address (42 postcode filled in)
